criteria: titleize("Ana Índia") 返回 "Ana Índia"（非 ASCII 词首 Í 保持大写）
原有公开接口行为不变：titleize 的 ASCII 用例、pluralize/singularize 的既有用例仍通过
limitations: 未覆盖 titleize 对其它非 ASCII 词首（如 élan、über）的期望，仅按目标验证 Ana Índia
未验证 Passerby/Passersby 等大小写变体

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import unittest

import inflection


class TestTitleizeUnicode(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_titleize_ana_india(self):
        self.assertEqual("Ana \u00cdndia", inflection.titleize("Ana \u00cdndia"))

    def test_titleize_ascii_unchanged(self):
        self.assertEqual("Active Record", inflection.titleize("active_record"))
        self.assertEqual("Action Web Service",
                         inflection.titleize("action web service"))
        self.assertEqual("David's Code", inflection.titleize("david's code"))


class TestPasserby(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_pluralize_passerby(self):
        self.assertEqual("passersby", inflection.pluralize("passerby"))

    def test_singularize_passersby(self):
        self.assertEqual("passerby", inflection.singularize("passersby"))

    def test_roundtrip(self):
        self.assertEqual("passersby",
                         inflection.pluralize(inflection.singularize("passersby")))


class TestExistingBehavior(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_pluralize_basic(self):
        self.assertEqual("posts", inflection.pluralize("post"))
        self.assertEqual("octopi", inflection.pluralize("octopus"))
        self.assertEqual("sheep", inflection.pluralize("sheep"))
        self.assertEqual("people", inflection.pluralize("person"))
        self.assertEqual("humans", inflection.pluralize("human"))

    def test_singularize_basic(self):
        self.assertEqual("post", inflection.singularize("posts"))
        self.assertEqual("octopus", inflection.singularize("octopi"))
        self.assertEqual("sheep", inflection.singularize("sheep"))
        self.assertEqual("person", inflection.singularize("people"))

    def test_other_public_api(self):
        self.assertEqual("DeviceType", inflection.camelize("device_type"))
        self.assertEqual("device_type", inflection.underscore("DeviceType"))
        self.assertEqual("puni-puni", inflection.dasherize("puni_puni"))
        self.assertEqual("Employee salary", inflection.humanize("employee_salary"))
        self.assertEqual("1st", inflection.ordinalize(1))
        self.assertEqual("donald-e-knuth",
                         inflection.parameterize(u"Donald E. Knuth"))
        self.assertEqual("people", inflection.tableize("person"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
